ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Five children should paint three quarters of the total amount of the little squares on their trays. One of the children A, B, C, D or E was wrong. Which one?

raw_record.question_text: Among children A, B, C, D, and E, which child did not paint three quarters of the little squares on the tray correctly?

method.method_draft: Inspect each labeled tray in the image and count both the total little squares and the painted/colored squares. From the text, use the requirement that the correct tray must have exactly three quarters of its little squares painted. Compute or compare counts: A has 3 painted out of 4, B has 9 out of 12, D has 6 out of 8, and E has 12 out of 16, all equal to 3/4. C has 6 painted out of 12, which is only 1/2, so C is the child who did not paint three quarters correctly.

planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the task asks which child among A, B, C, D, and E did not paint three quarters of the little squares correctly.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the fraction rule that three quarters means colored squares divided by total squares equals 3/4; equivalently, colored count should be 75% of the total.
